# DONGXIAO® Cashmere

> Premium B2B cashmere manufacturer and wholesale supplier from Ordos, Inner Mongolia, China. 23+ years expertise, OEKO-TEX certified, MOQ 100pcs, 7-day sampling, FOB Tianjin. Trusted by 500+ brands worldwide.

## Core Pages

- [Cashmere Wholesale Catalog (591 products)](https://www.erdosdx.com/en/products/): 5 categories: hats, scarves, sweaters, accessories, yarn. Filter by style, material, gauge, audience, pattern.
- [Ordos Cashmere Factory Tour](https://www.erdosdx.com/en/factory/): 23-year-old B2B source factory, 38,000 sqm, ISO certified, 1,200+ tons annual capacity.
- [Raw Cashmere Fiber (dehaired)](https://www.erdosdx.com/en/raw-material/): Combed top, roving, noil. White, brown (qing), purple (zi). MOQ 10kg per color.
- [Cashmere Yarn & Fabric](https://www.erdosdx.com/en/yarn-fabric/): 2/26 to 2/60 Nm, worsted & woolen, custom blends (cashmere/wool, cashmere/silk, cashmere/cotton).
- [Garment OEM & Private Label](https://www.erdosdx.com/en/garment-oem/): Full-package OEM/ODM, German STOLL knitting, 7-10 day sampling, 30-35 day lead time.
- [Contact & Quote Request](https://www.erdosdx.com/en/contact/): WhatsApp +86-156-6185-3999, email, B2B inquiry form. Response within 24h.
